default_rationale.ghi-276-historical: Preceded OBPI→feature direction for audit_behave_req_tags (GHI #276). Historical heavy-lane OBPI shipped without scenario-level @REQ-* tags; re-authoring attested evidence is itself doctrine drift. New heavy OBPIs must either add scenario tags or add an explicit rationale here.
default_rationale.adr-0.44.0-pre-release: ADR-0.44.0 vendor-alignment-codex is pre-release/draft (not yet promoted). Heavy-lane BDD scenario coverage deferred until the ADR is promoted and Gate 4 fires; waived to unblock ADR-0.0.20 closeout since the failing OBPIs are in unrelated downstream territory.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.21-bdd-deferred-to-obpi-07: ADR-0.0.21 (chores-as-gzkit-surface) decomposition explicitly routes all BDD scenario coverage for the chores surface to OBPI-0.0.21-07-bdd-chores-distribution. OBPIs 01-06, 08, 09 inherit this deferral by design; Gate 4 fires once on OBPI-07 and covers the physical migration, config/schema, packaging, resolver, scaffolder, rule/doc updates, layout validator, and chores doctor surfaces collectively. Re-authoring per-OBPI scenarios before OBPI-07 lands would duplicate work and contradict the parent ADR decomposition.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.22-foundation-bdd-deferred: ADR-0.0.22 (security-sensitivity-doctrine) is foundation/heavy-kind doctrine pinning a third orthogonal classification axis (sensitivity) alongside kind and lane. The decomposition (ADR § Implementation, line 63: "data/behave_coverage_waivers.json extension: foundation OBPIs deferring BDD per existing pattern") explicitly defers BDD across all six OBPIs because the verification surface is the schema/validator/audit-predicate layer (Pydantic schema enum, gz validate --sensitivity, _requires_security_review_attestation OR-branch, CANONICAL_STEP_COMMANDS slot, walkthrough prompt, rule-file scorecard) — naturally covered by Python unit tests under tests/governance/ and tests/commands/, not feature-level behave scenarios. End-to-end BDD coverage of the actual security-scan invocation belongs to the toolchain feature ADR that promotes pool.agentic-security-review (which authors bandit/semgrep/successor wiring). Same shape as foundation precedents ADR-0.0.17 (kind/semver binding) and ADR-0.0.18 (taxonomy doctrine): foundation invariants verified via Python tests; BDD reserved for the feature ADRs that wield them.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.24-0.0.25-uncommitted-draft: ADR-0.0.24 (attestation-receipt-binding) and ADR-0.0.25 (obpi-completion-req-coverage-gate) briefs are uncommitted draft work surfaced during OBPI-0.0.21-07 sync. Tracked under GHI #313 (plan-audit naming-drift) which already covers the broader untracked-WIP class. These ADRs must either author scenario-level @REQ-* tags under features/** or replace this temporary waiver with a substantive deferral rationale matching the eventual ADR decomposition. Waiver exists only to unblock OBPI-0.0.21-07 sync; not a free pass for ADR-0.0.24/0.0.25 to ship without coverage.
default_rationale.draft-brief-pre-implementation: Draft heavy-lane OBPI brief whose BDD scenarios are authored at implementation time (Gate 4 fires when the OBPI moves out of Draft). Waiver covers the Draft→In Progress window so the brief lands without forcing premature scenario authorship. Replace with a substantive rationale or remove the waiver when scenario tags are added during implementation.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.27-foundation-bdd-deferred: ADR-0.0.27 (exemplar-corpus-doctrine) is foundation/heavy-kind doctrine codifying the corpus selection methodology, distillation cadence, and citation contract. OBPI-0.0.27-01 is a rule-only OBPI with no CLI surface to scenario-test; verification is via Python unit tests asserting rule-body content (tests/governance/test_complexity_doctrine_rule.py). BDD coverage for the CLI surface (gz validate --complexity-doctrine-links) is deferred to OBPI-0.0.27-07 (link-integrity validator), which provides the scenario-testable surface. Same pattern as ADR-0.0.22 (adr-0.0.22-foundation-bdd-deferred): foundation invariants verified via Python tests; BDD reserved for the feature ADRs that wield them.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.27-04-bdd-deferred-to-obpi-06: OBPI-0.0.27-04 (distillation-pass) is a programmatic library + document-renderer surface (src/gzkit/complexity/distillation.py) consumed by OBPI-0.0.27-06 (gz-complexity-distill skill). Verification is via unittest at tests/complexity/test_distillation.py (8 REQ-derived assertions on frontmatter contract, per-metric triple shape, cold-start diff sentinel, subsequent-run boundary-movement narration, no-overwrite preservation, citation-form section, and operator-attested practitioner-eye placeholder). BDD coverage for the operator-runnable invocation surface (gz-complexity-distill skill) is deferred to OBPI-0.0.27-06 per brief REQ-07: "BDD scenario tagged @REQ-0.0.27-04-NN covers a synthetic distillation invocation against fixture baseline (or registered as waived if the OBPI-06 skill scenario covers it)." Same pattern as adr-0.0.27-foundation-bdd-deferred: foundation invariants verified via Python tests; BDD reserved for the feature/skill OBPIs that wield them.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.27-03-real-clone-too-heavy-for-c: OBPI-0.0.27-03 (measurement-pipeline) verifies a programmatic library (src/gzkit/complexity/measurement.py) consumed by future OBPI-04 (distillation pass) and OBPI-06 (gz-complexity-distill skill). The pipeline orchestrates radon/lizard/cohesion subprocess invocations against pinned-SHA clones of 13 corpus projects (Django, Starlette, urllib3, etc.). End-to-end BDD coverage requires real clones of all 13 large repositories at pinned SHAs and real subprocess invocation of the three measurement tools, which exceeds CI's reasonable budget by orders of magnitude (~3-5 GB of cloned source, ~minutes per run). The brief authorizes this waiver explicitly: REQ-0.0.27-03-09 says "Real-clone integration coverage is deferred to a behave scenario gated under a tag waivable per existing waiver registry." Verification surface for OBPI-03 is the unittest tier under tests/complexity/, which mocks the clone-and-measure seam (`_resolve_tree`) and asserts orchestration, path-filter respect, named-error fail-closed, deterministic JSON, list-form subprocess discipline, and schema rejection. Real-clone integration coverage will land at OBPI-04 invocation when the first dated baseline artifact is produced under operator witness.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.27-06-deferred-to-ghi-400-cli-ve: OBPI-0.0.27-06 (gz-complexity-distill skill) ships under the destination-verb waiver path (REQUIREMENT 9 amended) tracked by GHI #400. The skill body is authored, vendor mirrors propagate byte-equal, and frontmatter declares gz_command_status: deferred + deferred_gh_issue: 400. There is no operator-runnable CLI verb to BDD-scenario-test until GHI #400 lands; the destination verb (gz complexity distill or equivalent) will carry its own scenario at registration time. Per the brief Gate 4 line: "BDD scenario tagged @REQ-0.0.27-06-NN covers a skill invocation against fixture corpus + fixture baseline (or registered as waived if OBPI-04 BDD scenario covers it transitively)." OBPI-04 itself was waived to OBPI-06 (rationale adr-0.0.27-04-bdd-deferred-to-obpi-06), so the chain forwards to GHI #400. Replace this waiver with a substantive scenario when GHI #400 lands the destination verb. Same shape as adr-0.0.27-foundation-bdd-deferred and adr-0.0.22-foundation-bdd-deferred: foundation invariants verified via Python tests; BDD reserved for the operator-runnable CLI surface that wields them.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.28-foundation-bdd-deferred: ADR-0.0.28 (complexity-threshold-doctrine) is foundation/heavy-kind doctrine codifying the per-metric threshold table for the complexity-doctrine cluster. OBPI-0.0.28-01 is a rule-only OBPI with no CLI surface to scenario-test; verification is via Python unit tests asserting rule-body content (tests/governance/test_complexity_thresholds_rule.py — 11 REQ-derived tests on frontmatter, vocabulary cardinality, per-metric block bands, percentile+absolute pairing, citation tuple, operator-amendable mapping protocol, scorecard, vendor mirrors, and bootstrap-absolutes carve-out). BDD coverage for the CLI surface (gz validate --complexity-thresholds) is deferred to OBPI-0.0.28-03 (validator), which provides the scenario-testable surface. Same pattern as adr-0.0.27-foundation-bdd-deferred: foundation invariants verified via Python tests; BDD reserved for the validator OBPI that wields them.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.29-foundation-bdd-deferred: ADR-0.0.29 (complexity-advisor) is foundation/heavy-kind doctrine codifying the trigger-time response surface for the complexity-doctrine cluster. OBPI-0.0.29-01 is a schema-only OBPI authoring frozen Pydantic models (AdvisorDiagnosis, RefactorArchetype StrEnum, DoctrinalFrame, ProofRange, IntrinsicAttestationRef forward stub) plus a JSON Schema mirror; there is no CLI surface to scenario-test at this layer. Verification is via Python unit tests at tests/complexity/advisor/test_diagnosis.py — 12 tests asserting valid instantiation, empty-proof rejection, enum constraints (archetype, authority, crossing_band), end_line>=start_line cross-field guard, frozen-mutation rejection, JSON Schema validation against canonical fixtures, JSON Schema rejection of empty proof + unknown enums, and extra='forbid' on all four model classes. BDD coverage for the operator-runnable CLI surface (gz complexity-advise) is deferred to OBPI-0.0.29-03 (CLI verb), which provides the scenario-testable surface. Same pattern as adr-0.0.27-foundation-bdd-deferred and adr-0.0.28-foundation-bdd-deferred: foundation invariants verified via Python tests; BDD reserved for the CLI/skill OBPIs that wield them.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.29-05-req07-meta-requirement: REQ-0.0.29-05-07 is a meta-requirement asserting that tests exist with @covers decorators and tempfile-backed fixtures. This is structurally verified at the unit tier (TestCoversDecorators.test_tests_use_tempfile_and_covers) and is not behaviorally scenario-testable in behave. The remaining REQ-05 and REQ-06 are tagged on the warn-band and block-band behave scenarios.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.29-06-partial-reqs-unit-only: OBPI-0.0.29-06-ad-hoc-path (ad-hoc vs auto-chain presenter dispatch) brief REQ-07 explicitly limits BDD scenarios to REQ-{01,02,03}: clean-file, warn-band ad-hoc, and warn-band auto-chain paths. REQs 04 (clean ad-hoc metrics count), 05 (clean auto-chain silent), and 06 (presenter protocol substitutability) are structural unit-test-only verification surfaces: REQ-04 and REQ-05 are additional clean-file variants of the already-scenario-tested pathways (no new operator-visible behavior), and REQ-06 is Python Protocol conformance (isinstance/callable checks), not a CLI-observable scenario. Unit tests at tests/commands/test_complexity_advise_ad_hoc.py cover all 6 REQs via @covers decorators (10 tests). REQs 01, 02, 03 carry @REQ-0.0.29-06-{01,02,03} tags in features/complexity_advise_ad_hoc.feature. Same shape as adr-0.0.29-05-req07-meta-requirement.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.30-01-req06-cli-audit-static-doc: OBPI-0.0.30-01 REQ-06 (gz cli audit covers manpage + command doc + index for the new verb) is a static documentation-coverage check, not a behaviorally scenario-testable surface. The check requires the project's config/doc-coverage.json + docs/user/manpages/index.md + docs/user/runbook.md present in the working tree, but behave scenarios run in a temp gzkit-init'd project where those files are not the project canon. Verification is via tests/commands/test_complexity_guide.py::TestComplexityGuideCliAuditParity.test_cli_audit_covers_complexity_guide which calls check_surfaces_report(get_project_root()) directly and asserts complexity_guide.all_passed across all surfaces (manpage, index_entry, operator_runbook, governance_runbook). REQs 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 are scenario-tagged in features/complexity_guide.feature.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.30-foundation-bdd-deferred: ADR-0.0.30 (complexity-authoring-guidance) is foundation/heavy-kind doctrine codifying the upstream-prevention complement to ADR-0.0.29. OBPI-0.0.30-03 is a schema+engine OBPI: AuthoringHint frozen Pydantic model, project_diagnosis_to_hint projection, and authoring-time hint engine wrapping DiagnosisEngine. There is no CLI surface to scenario-test at this layer. Verification is via Python unit tests at tests/complexity/authoring/test_hint.py and tests/complexity/authoring/test_engine.py (24 tests covering all 8 REQs via @covers decorators). BDD coverage for the operator-runnable surface (gz complexity guide) is deferred to OBPI-0.0.30-01 (CLI verb), which provides the scenario-testable surface. Same pattern as adr-0.0.29-foundation-bdd-deferred: foundation engine-internal OBPIs verified via Python tests; BDD reserved for the CLI/skill OBPIs that wield them.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.30-02-skill-only-bdd-deferred: OBPI-0.0.30-02 is a skill-doc-only OBPI with no CLI or Python source changes. The verification surface is the SKILL.md document shape tested by Python unit tests in tests/skills/test_complexity_guide.py (16 tests covering REQ-0.0.30-02-01 through REQ-0.0.30-02-06 via @covers decorators). Behave BDD scenarios for the operator-runnable surface (gz complexity guide) are in OBPI-0.0.30-01 (CLI verb). Skill-layer OBPIs do not add scenario-testable CLI surfaces independent of the CLI OBPI that wields the same verb. Same pattern as adr-0.0.27-06-deferred-to-ghi-400-cli-verb and the complexity-advisor skill OBPI: skill authorship is verified via Python tests; BDD reserved for the CLI OBPI.
default_rationale.adr-0.0.32-bdd-deferred-to-obpi-06: ADR-0.0.32 (canonical-surface-packaging) decomposition explicitly routes BDD scenario coverage to OBPI-0.0.32-06 (T0 smoke test in features/distribution_invariant.feature - build wheel, install into temp venv, run gz init, assert byte-equivalence against frozen baseline manifest). OBPI-0.0.32-01 (skills physical migration) is a layout-only OBPI establishing the dual-surface contract: .gzkit/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md (authored canonical source) plus src/gzkit/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md (synced package copy). Its REQs are mechanically verified via Python unit tests at tests/test_skills.py: 26 tests covering all 8 REQs via @covers decorators (dual-surface presence, byte parity, public-symbol re-exports, skills_audit sibling imports, scaffolder signature preservation, pyproject preservation, template preservation, full import resolution). The brief Gate 4 line is explicit: 'No new behave scenarios in this OBPI; existing scenarios that exercise gz init MUST continue to pass with the post-migration layout (regression-only signal).' End-to-end BDD coverage of the wheel-install-and-init flow lives at OBPI-0.0.32-06. Same pattern as adr-0.0.21-bdd-deferred-to-obpi-07: physical-migration / layout OBPIs verified via Python tests; BDD reserved for the wheel-install-and-init OBPI that wields them.
default_rationale.adr-0.47.0-bdd-deferred-to-obpi-03-and-o: ADR-0.47.0 (owasp-top10-2025-scan) decomposition explicitly routes BDD scenario coverage to OBPI-0.47.0-03 (CLI verb gz scan owasp) and OBPI-0.47.0-05 (gzkit dogfood pass + Gate-5 attestation). OBPI-0.47.0-01 (data model + mapping schema) is a Pydantic-and-JSON-Schema-only OBPI with no operator-runnable CLI surface; its REQs (mapping-validates-against-schema, A06-must-be-not-mechanical, mechanical-floor-invariant, A07-must-be-not-applicable, round-trip-equality, path-serialization-posix) are all schema invariants verified by Python unittest at tests/scan/test_owasp_models.py and tests/scan/test_owasp_mapping.py (7 tests, all six REQs covered via @covers decorators). The brief Gate 4 line is explicit: 'N/A — this brief lands schema only; behavioural scenarios live in OBPI-03 (CLI) and OBPI-05 (dogfood).' Same pattern as adr-0.0.29-foundation-bdd-deferred and adr-0.0.30-foundation-bdd-deferred: schema/engine OBPIs verified via Python tests; BDD reserved for the CLI / dogfood OBPIs that wield them.

OBPI-0.0.29-04-complexity-advisor-skill.rationale: Skill-only OBPI; CLI scenarios covered at OBPI-0.0.29-03. No additional BDD surface.

OBPI-0.0.29-09-advisor-timeout-fallback.rationale: Brief REQ-08 explicitly mandates BDD for REQs 02 and 03 only (timeout-and-log path). REQs 01 (ok/timed_out return semantics), 04 (configurable timeout from config key), and 05 (no subprocess, stdlib-only) are unit-test-only verification surfaces with no operator-visible CLI or hook behavior to scenario-test. Unit tests at tests/complexity/advisor/test_timeout.py provide full REQ coverage (14 tests, 5/5 REQs covered via @covers). Same pattern as adr-0.0.29-foundation-bdd-deferred: foundation invariants verified via Python tests; BDD reserved for the operator-facing paths.

OBPI-0.0.29-07-intrinsic-complexity-atte.rationale: REQ-0.0.29-07-02 (decorator no-op at runtime) and REQ-0.0.29-07-06 (validate --documents recognizes event shape) are verified by unit tests only. REQ-02 is an in-process Python decorator property with no CLI observable surface; BDD subprocess boundary cannot observe the registry state. REQ-06 is exercised by tests/governance/test_intrinsic_attestation_event.py (8 tests, all @covers REQ-0.0.29-07-06). BDD covers REQ-01 (decorator path renders attestation), REQ-03 (non-crossing guard), REQ-04 (TTY+ATTEST emits event), and REQ-05 (headless guard).

OBPI-0.0.29-08-verdict-proof-binding.rationale: Brief REQ-0.0.29-08-08 explicitly limits BDD scenarios to REQ-02 and REQ-03 (the two canonical failure paths). The remaining REQs are structurally verified at the unit tier in tests/governance/test_advisor_proof_binding_validator.py (16 tests, 100% REQ coverage via gz covers OBPI-0.0.29-08 -> 6/6): REQ-01 (vacuous and well-formed fixture pass) is a happy-path counterpart to REQ-02 with no new operator-visible behavior; REQ-04 (JSON Schema minItems audit) tests the validator's structural assertion against a synthetic schema fixture, not a CLI-observable scenario; REQ-05 (error message quality - file:line for fixtures, event id for ledger) is asserted via TestErrorMessageQuality.{test_fixture_error_cites_path_and_line,test_ledger_error_cites_event_id} unit tests; REQ-06 (speculative-marker escape) tests an internal short-circuit (_NEGATIVE_CASE_KEY) that has no behaviorally distinct CLI output - the validator simply skips the file and returns []. BDD scenarios at features/advisor_proof_binding.feature carry @REQ-0.0.29-08-02 + @REQ-0.0.29-08-03 tags. Same shape as adr-0.0.29-06-partial-reqs-unit-only.
